summary.tldr: Creates a new Criminal Code offence for violent home invasion and adds it to sentencing, bail and related rules.
what_it_does: Creates a new offence of violent home invasion for anyone who enters or is in an occupied dwelling-house without lawful excuse and uses intimidation, violence, threats, bodily harm, confinement, or a weapon.
Sets the penalty for violent home invasion at up to life in prison, with a minimum sentence of five years.
Requires courts to treat violent home invasion as an aggravating circumstance when sentencing for certain other offences tied to a dwelling-house.
Adds violent home invasion to the list of primary designated offences under the Criminal Code.
Adds violent home invasion to the bail rules that apply to certain listed offences.
